Config file descriptors for default, testnet, devnet, and mainnet embedded data.

# Purpose
This header declares embedded configuration data for several Firedancer network profiles: `default`, `testnet`, `devnet`, and `mainnet`. It includes `fd_config_file.h` and declares external byte arrays and size values for each configuration image. The functions [`fd_config_file_default`](<#fd_config_file_default>), [`fd_config_file_testnet`](<#fd_config_file_testnet>), [`fd_config_file_devnet`](<#fd_config_file_devnet>), and [`fd_config_file_mainnet`](<#fd_config_file_mainnet>) each return an `fd_config_file_t` record that names the profile and points to the matching data buffer and size. This file acts as a small factory for creating configuration file descriptors from built-in configuration content.
